issue.title: sase artifact link add (and sase bead read with links) fails for valid bead refs: 'bead id segment must contain only letters, digits, - and _'

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent following /sase_new_task loses typed related links; sase bead read needs --no-links to show any bead.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core crates/sase_core/src/artifact_ref/mod.rs validate_bead_id (reached from sase artifact link add and the sase bead read link renderer)
task_type_fields.repro:
## Bug

On 2026-10-05, in sase workspace sase_10 at sase 17c2907d3b with the pinned core fe2ef0e6 (sase_core_rs 0.36.5), every `sase artifact link add` fails before writing, for any pair of valid bead refs:

    $ sase artifact link add bead:sase-1gq related bead:sase-1fj "why"
    Error: validation: bead id segment must contain only letters, digits, '-' and '_'

`sase bead read <id>` fails the same way unless run with `--no-links`, for example `sase bead read sase-1eq -r ...`. Its hint says to rerun with --no-links, so the failure is in artifact-link resolution. Read-only `sase artifact link list bead:sase-1eq -j` and `sase bead ref list` still work.

The message comes from `validate_bead_id` in sase-core crates/sase_core/src/artifact_ref/mod.rs (~line 1332). That lexical validator rejects any '.'-separated segment containing a character other than [A-Za-z0-9_-]. So some ref that link add and the bead-read link renderer both parse carries a bead id with an illegal segment. Candidates: a stored link row, a note-attachment ref, or the creating-agent ref (names like `sase-1eq.land` and `bbugyi200.athena.sase-1eq.11.w0` show up in the link rows). The offending row or value has not been identified.

Impact: agents cannot record typed `related` links, which /sase_new_task requires. On 2026-10-05 alone, the authors of sase-1gj, sase-1gl, and the sase-1eq landing hit this and fell back to prose notes. Bead reads also lose their link sections.

Repro: run either command above from any sase workspace on that date. To find the culprit, wrap the binding's ref parse to log the rejected bead id, or scan the artifact-link event store and note-attachment refs for bead ids that fail the validator.

Related, possibly causal (typed links could not be added because of this bug): epics sase-yy / sase-yy.8.6 (immutable artifact-link events and publication recovery) and sase-w3 (artifact link-follow reliability).

issue.creation_reason: Typed artifact links cannot be recorded at all right now, and on 2026-10-05 three agents independently worked around the error in prose notes without filing it.
